
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在实际工作中，PDF 的页面尺寸往往决定了它能否顺利打印、归档或嵌入到其他系统里。比如，一份为 A3 设计的报表需要缩成 A4 分发，或者扫描件需要统一到某个自定义尺寸。手动逐页调整既耗时又容易出错，用 Python 脚本批量处理会是更稳妥的选择。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.PDF for Python 是这个场景下轻量且够用的工具之一。它体积小，API 设计也比较直接，适合做页面级别的重构。下面从原理到代码，完整梳理一遍用它修改 PDF 页面尺寸的几种常见做法。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">准备工作</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">只需要通过 pip 安装即可：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install spire.pdf.free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">免费版本对文档页数有一定限制（通常为 10 页以内），适合小规模处理或验证方案。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心思路：为什么不能“直接改尺寸”？</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDF 的页面尺寸（MediaBox）虽然在规范层面是一个可修改的属性，但直接改动它会导致原本按旧尺寸排布的文字、图片发生错位甚至被裁剪。更可靠的做法是“另起炉灶”：</span></p>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">加载原文档</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，逐页创建页面模板（Template），把该页的全部内容“快照”下来。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">新建一个文档</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，按照目标尺寸创建空白页面。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">把模板绘制到新页面上</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，通过控制绘制坐标和缩放布局，实现内容的适配。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">保存新文档</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，释放资源。</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.PDF 的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPageBase.CreateTemplate()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfTemplate.Draw()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 正是为这个流程设计的。无论目标尺寸是变大、变小还是改变宽高比，都可以用同一套逻辑完成。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景一：更改为标准纸张尺寸（A3、B4、Letter 等）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.PDF 内置了常见的标准纸张枚举，如 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPageSize.A3()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPageSize.B4()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPageSize.Letter()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等。下面的代码把一份 PDF 的每一页都转换为 B4：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>input_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"source.pdf"</span><br>
output_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"resized_b4.pdf"</span></p>
<p>original_pdf = PdfDocument()<br>
original_pdf.LoadFromFile(input_file)</p>
<p>new_pdf = PdfDocument()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> i <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>(original_pdf.Pages.Count):<br>
page = original_pdf.Pages.get_Item(i)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建 B4 尺寸的新页面，边距设为 0，避免额外留白</span><br>
new_page = new_pdf.Pages.Add(PdfPageSize.B4(), PdfMargins(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.0</span>))</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 关键：将文本布局设为 OnePage，让原内容整体缩放到新页面内</span><br>
layout = PdfTextLayout()<br>
layout.Layout = PdfLayoutType.OnePage</p>
<p>template = page.CreateTemplate()<br>
template.Draw(new_page, PointF.Empty(), layout)</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">new_pdf.SaveToFile(output_file)<br>
new_pdf.Close()<br>
original_pdf.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这里的关键是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfLayoutType.OnePage</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。如果不设置这个布局，内容会按原始比例绘制，超出新页面尺寸的部分会被直接裁掉，而不是自动缩放。设置之后，模板会根据新页面的可用区域整体缩放，保证内容完整可见。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景二：自定义尺寸（毫米、英寸等任意单位）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实际需求中，目标尺寸很少恰好是标准纸张。比如印刷品可能要求 200mm × 280mm，或者某个系统规定页面必须是 6 × 9 英寸。Free Spire.PDF 的度量单位是</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">点（point）</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，1 点 = 1/72 英寸。用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfUnitConvertor</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可以先把物理单位转成点，再创建 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">SizeF</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>input_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"source.pdf"</span><br>
output_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"custom_size.pdf"</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 目标尺寸：200mm × 280mm</span><br>
converter = PdfUnitConvertor()<br>
width_pt = converter.ConvertUnits(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">200</span>, PdfGraphicsUnit.Millimeter, PdfGraphicsUnit.Point)<br>
height_pt = converter.ConvertUnits(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">280</span>, PdfGraphicsUnit.Millimeter, PdfGraphicsUnit.Point)</p>
<p>original_pdf = PdfDocument()<br>
original_pdf.LoadFromFile(input_file)</p>
<p>new_pdf = PdfDocument()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> i <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>(original_pdf.Pages.Count):<br>
page = original_pdf.Pages.get_Item(i)</p>
<p>new_page = new_pdf.Pages.Add(SizeF(width_pt, height_pt), PdfMargins(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.0</span>))</p>
<p>layout = PdfTextLayout()<br>
layout.Layout = PdfLayoutType.OnePage</p>
<p>template = page.CreateTemplate()<br>
template.Draw(new_page, PointF.Empty(), layout)</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">new_pdf.SaveToFile(output_file)<br>
new_pdf.Close()<br>
original_pdf.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ConvertUnits</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的第一个参数是数值，第二个是源单位，第三个是目标单位。支持的单位包括 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Millimeter</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Inch</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Pixel</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Point</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等。如果不确定原始页面的尺寸，可以先读取出来作为参考：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">page = original_pdf.Pages[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"原页面尺寸: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{page.Size.Width}</span> × <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{page.Size.Height}</span> points"</span>)
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景三：按比例缩放（放大或缩小）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">有时目标不是某个固定的物理尺寸，而是“整体放大 1.2 倍”或“缩到 80%”。这只需要在原尺寸基础上乘以系数，逻辑比前两种场景更简单：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.pdf <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>input_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"source.pdf"</span><br>
output_file = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"scaled_120.pdf"</span></p>
<p>scale = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1.2</span></p>
<p>original_pdf = PdfDocument()<br>
original_pdf.LoadFromFile(input_file)</p>
<p>new_pdf = PdfDocument()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> i <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>(original_pdf.Pages.Count):<br>
page = original_pdf.Pages.get_Item(i)</p>
<p>new_width = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>(page.Size.Width * scale)<br>
new_height = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">float</span>(page.Size.Height * scale)<br>
new_page = new_pdf.Pages.Add(SizeF(new_width, new_height), PdfMargins(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.0</span>))</p>
<p>layout = PdfTextLayout()<br>
layout.Layout = PdfLayoutType.OnePage</p>
<p>template = page.CreateTemplate()<br>
template.Draw(new_page, PointF.Empty(), layout)</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">new_pdf.SaveToFile(output_file)<br>
new_pdf.Close()<br>
original_pdf.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">按比例缩放时，所有页面的宽高比保持不变，内容不会因为拉伸而变形。</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfLayoutType.OnePage</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 在这里主要起保险作用：即使某页的原始尺寸与其他页略有差异，也能保证内容完整落入新页面。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">小结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过页面模板重绘的方式调整 PDF 页面尺寸，是比较稳定可靠的方案，适合自动化批量规整文档页面。核心流程可以概括为四步：</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">读原页 → 建模板 → 开新页 → 画上去</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。实际操作中你可以根据业务需求调整缩放逻辑、边距、对齐方式。</span></p></section>

</div>
